evidence.reason: The re-fix branch builds `reviewed` solely from fingerprints present in any covered review (`scripts/measurement-outcomes.mjs:222-224`) and line 242 checks only `reviewed.has(key)`. It never checks that the covered review's `baseSha`/`headSha` range contains the disposition's `observedHead`, despite the comment at lines 218-221 requiring that lineage. Thus a re-fix at an unrelated head can be counted as a harm candidate merely because some other covered review names the same fingerprint. This is an implementation failure of the stated lineage condition, not a request for a new requirement.
